title: I Left the Monitor-Arm Photo on the Desk They Rolled to the Corner

parts.text: I sat at desk 14 at 8:06 a.m. and my numbered monitor arm was in the corner. Tess from sales had rolled it to her favorite window. I was twenty-eight, designer, holding a booking that listed desk 14. I photographed the empty clamp, the corner, and the board that said ARMS STAY WITH THE DESK. Then I left the photo on the desk they rolled. At 8:14 facilities pinged Tess. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Tess rolled it back. Policy now has a second line: WINDOWS ARE NOT BOOKINGS. I keep the clamp labeled. The floor finally looks like a map, not a scavenger hunt.
